title: Open scalar exchange from its unit transposes
statement: For four open adjunctions arranged in a coefficient and pullback cube, suppose the two scalar open maps and the two open exchange maps have the prescribed unit transposes. If scalar pullback comparisons satisfy the displayed inverse-image cube, then inverse scalar balancing and the forward open exchange maps satisfy the coefficient square in the Lean statement.

source.place: Compatibility (3), Open scalar exchange from its unit transposes

proof.text: Apply the target open adjunction Hom bijection. Naturality of its unit, the exchange unit equation, square naturality, and scalar-open unit normalization compute one transpose. The corresponding normalization and naturality compute the other. Their equality is the assumed inverse-image cube precomposed with scalar pullback of the source unit.

theorem openScalar_exchange_of_unit
    {C C' D D' E E' F F' : Type*}
    [Category C] [Category C'] [Category D] [Category D']
    [Category E] [Category E'] [Category F] [Category F']
    {L : C ⥤ D} {J : D ⥤ C} {L' : C' ⥤ D'} {J' : D' ⥤ C'}
    {N : E ⥤ F} {R : F ⥤ E} {N' : E' ⥤ F'} {R' : F' ⥤ E'}
    (a : L ⊣ J) (a' : L' ⊣ J') (b : N ⊣ R) (b' : N' ⊣ R')
    (H : C ⥤ C') (He : E ⥤ E') (G : D ⥤ D') (Ge : F ⥤ F')
    (S : C ⥤ E) (S' : C' ⥤ E') (Q : D ⥤ F) (Q' : D' ⥤ F')
    (eg : Q ⋙ Ge ≅ G ⋙ Q') (eh : S ⋙ He ≅ H ⋙ S')
    (ej : Q ⋙ R ≅ J ⋙ S) (ej' : Q' ⋙ R' ≅ J' ⋙ S')
    (c : J ⋙ H ≅ G ⋙ J') (ce : R ⋙ He ≅ Ge ⋙ R')
    (i : S ⋙ N ⟶ L ⋙ Q) (i' : S' ⋙ N' ⟶ L' ⋙ Q')
    (d : H ⋙ L' ⟶ L ⋙ G) (de : He ⋙ N' ⟶ N ⋙ Ge)
    (hi : ∀ M, b.unit.app (S.obj M) ≫ R.map (i.app M) =
      S.map (a.unit.app M) ≫ ej.inv.app (L.obj M))
    (hi' : ∀ M, b'.unit.app (S'.obj M) ≫ R'.map (i'.app M) =
      S'.map (a'.unit.app M) ≫ ej'.inv.app (L'.obj M))
    (hd : ∀ M, a'.unit.app (H.obj M) ≫ J'.map (d.app M) =
      H.map (a.unit.app M) ≫ c.hom.app (L.obj M))
    (hde : ∀ M, b'.unit.app (He.obj M) ≫ R'.map (de.app M) =
      He.map (b.unit.app M) ≫ ce.hom.app (N.obj M))
    (hcube : ∀ K, S'.map (c.hom.app K) ≫ ej'.inv.app (G.obj K) ≫
      R'.map (eg.inv.app K) =
      eh.inv.app (J.obj K) ≫ He.map (ej.inv.app K) ≫ ce.hom.app (Q.obj K))
    (M : C) :
    N'.map (eh.inv.app M) ≫ de.app (S.obj M) ≫ Ge.map (i.app M) =
      i'.app (H.obj M) ≫ Q'.map (d.app M) ≫ eg.inv.app (L.obj M)
